summary: The agent informed the consumer of a $1,400 overdue balance and offered payment options. The consumer proposed paying $700 now and $700 the following month. The agent agreed to note the split and said a supervisor would need to approve it, with a follow‑up promised by Friday.

decisions.text: Agent will obtain supervisor approval for the $700 today and $700 on the 15th of next month payment split and will follow up with the consumer by Friday

action_items.text: Agent will follow up by Friday

blockers.text: Supervisor approval required for the proposed split payment plan, delaying finalization of the agreement

compliance_flags.text: Agent confirmed the call was being recorded at the start of the interaction, satisfying consent requirements.
Agent presented the standard payment options, including a single payment or two equal installments, providing the consumer with clear repayment choices.
Agent indicated that a supervisor's approval was required for the proposed split payment arrangement, aligning with policy that deviations from standard terms need supervisory sign‑off.

sentiment.notes: Both parties remain cooperative and focused on payment arrangement
